transcript:
W: Hi, I bought this coffee maker here last week, but it stopped heating the water after two days.
M: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have your receipt with you?
W: Yes, here it is. I'd like to exchange it for the same model if possible.
M: Let me check our stock. Hmm, it looks like we're sold out of that model at the moment.
W: That's disappointing. I really liked the size of it.
M: We're expecting a delivery on Thursday. I can put one aside for you and call you when it arrives.
W: That works. My number is on the receipt.

questions.content: Where most likely are the speakers?
questions.explanation: Người phụ nữ nói 'I bought this coffee maker here last week' và người đàn ông kiểm tra kho hàng → họ ở cửa hàng đồ gia dụng (A). (B) bẫy từ 'coffee', (C) không ai nhắc sửa chữa.

questions.content: What problem does the man mention?
options: An item is out of stock.
questions.explanation: Người đàn ông nói 'we're sold out of that model at the moment' → hết hàng (B). (A) sai vì người phụ nữ có hóa đơn, (C), (D) không được nhắc.

questions.content: What does the man offer to do?
options: Reserve an item for the woman
questions.explanation: 'I can put one aside for you and call you when it arrives' = giữ lại một chiếc cho cô ấy (C). (A), (B), (D) không được đề nghị.

transcript:
M: Good evening. Welcome to the Harbor View Hotel. Checking in?
W: Yes, the reservation is under Sato. I booked a double room for two nights.
M: Thank you, Ms. Sato. I see your reservation here. Unfortunately, the room isn't quite ready yet. Housekeeping is finishing it now.
W: Oh, I was hoping to change for a dinner meeting at seven.
M: It should be ready in about twenty minutes. In the meantime, you're welcome to wait in our lounge. Coffee and tea are complimentary.
W: All right. Could you also send my suitcase up when the room is ready?
M: Of course. I'll have it taken up right away.

questions.content: Why is the woman unable to go to her room?
options: She arrived on the wrong date.
The room is still being cleaned.
Her key card does not work.
questions.explanation: Lễ tân nói 'the room isn't quite ready yet. Housekeeping is finishing it now' → phòng đang được dọn (C). (B) sai vì đã tìm thấy đặt phòng, (A), (D) không nhắc.

questions.content: What does the woman say she will do at seven o'clock?
options: Meet a friend in the lounge
questions.explanation: 'I was hoping to change for a dinner meeting at seven' → tham dự bữa tối công việc (A). (D) bẫy từ 'lounge' (chỗ chờ phòng).

questions.content: What does the man say the woman can do while she waits?
options: Store her luggage in a locker
Book a table at a restaurant
questions.explanation: 'you're welcome to wait in our lounge. Coffee and tea are complimentary' → được uống miễn phí (A). (C) sai vì hành lý sẽ được mang lên phòng, (B), (D) không nhắc.

transcript:
M1: Thanks for meeting with us, Ms. Rivera. I'm Daniel, and this is my colleague Pavel from the travel desk.
W: Nice to meet you both. You said you need help planning a company trip?
M2: That's right. We're taking forty employees to the regional sales conference in Lisbon next month.
M1: We'd like one agency to handle the flights, the hotel, and transportation from the airport.
W: We can certainly do that. Have you set a budget yet?
M2: Not exactly. Our director wants to see a few options first.
W: Then I'll prepare three packages at different price levels. I can send them to you by Friday.

questions.content: Who most likely is the woman?
questions.explanation: Hai người đàn ông nhờ cô ấy lo vé máy bay, khách sạn và đưa đón cho chuyến đi ('one agency to handle the flights, the hotel…') → nhân viên đại lý du lịch (B). (A), (D) bẫy từ 'conference', 'director'.
'We're taking forty employees to the regional sales conference in Lisbon' → chuyến đi cho nhân viên (C). (A), (B), (D) không được nhắc.

questions.content: What does the woman say she will do by Friday?
questions.explanation: 'I'll prepare three packages at different price levels. I can send them to you by Friday' → gửi vài lựa chọn (D). (B) chưa đặt gì, (C) bẫy từ 'director'.

transcript:
W: Hi, Marco. Did you see the new customer comment cards from the weekend?
M: I did. Most of them were positive, but several people said they waited too long to be seated.
W: Saturday nights are always busy. We had only two hosts at the front.
M: Maybe we should start taking reservations through our Web site. Customers could choose a time in advance.
W: The owner has talked about that before. It's not a bad idea.
M: Great. I'll look into some online booking services and compare their prices.
W: Good. Let's discuss it at Monday's staff meeting.

questions.content: What did some customers complain about?
questions.explanation: 'several people said they waited too long to be seated' → chờ lâu (B). (A), (C), (D) không được nhắc.

questions.content: What does the woman mean when she says, "It's not a bad idea"?
options: She thinks the man's suggestion is worth trying.
She believes the owner will disagree.
She wants to hire more hosts.
questions.explanation: Người đàn ông đề xuất nhận đặt bàn qua website; cô ấy nói 'It's not a bad idea' và sau đó đồng ý bàn tiếp → cô ấy thấy đề xuất đáng thử (A). (C) trái ý vì chủ quán từng nhắc tới việc này.

questions.content: What will the man do next?
questions.explanation: 'I'll look into some online booking services and compare their prices' → tìm hiểu dịch vụ đặt bàn trực tuyến (C). (A) không nói sẽ gọi, (D) bẫy từ 'staff meeting'.

transcript:
M: Excuse me, I'm flying to Singapore, but I think I missed the announcement. Has my gate changed?
W: Let me check. Your flight number is SG 208?
M: Yes, that's right. It was supposed to leave from Gate 14.
W: It's been moved. It's now leaving from the same gate as the Chicago flight, which departed an hour ago.
M: Oh, I see. Is it far from here?
W: About a ten-minute walk. If you'd prefer, you can take the electric cart at the end of this hallway.
M: Thanks. I'll take the cart. I'm carrying a heavy bag.

questions.content: What is the man concerned about?
options: He may have missed some information.
His luggage is too heavy to check in.
questions.explanation: 'I think I missed the announcement. Has my gate changed?' → lo đã bỏ lỡ thông tin (B). (C) sai vì chuyến bay chỉ đổi cổng, (D) bẫy từ 'heavy bag'.

questions.content: Look at the graphic. Which gate will the man go to?
questions.explanation: Chuyến bay của anh ấy dời sang 'the same gate as the Chicago flight'; theo bảng, chuyến đi Chicago dùng Gate 21 → (C). (A) là cổng cũ, (D) là cổng của chuyến đi Seoul.

questions.content: What does the man decide to do?
questions.explanation: 'I'll take the cart. I'm carrying a heavy bag' → đi xe điện (A). (B) là phương án anh ấy không chọn.
